critic_scores.rationale: The revision fails to address the previously flagged factual omission [FC-001]: the critical V2 (verb-second) rule of Swedish word order is still entirely absent. The response remains factually incomplete and misleading as a description of Swedish sentence structure.

critic_scores.rationale: The response is extremely confusing and incoherent, failing to communicate the basic word order in Swedish sentences effectively.
